Claim 1 (Currently amended): A loading ramp, said loading ramp comprising: a support structure having a mounting member, said mounting member being compatible with a truck having a bed such that said support structure is adapted to be removably mounted to the truck; a first gradient member secured to said support structure, said first gradient member defining a first surface, a proximate end, and a distal end, the proximate end being opposite the distal end with respect to the first surface, the proximate end being proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, the first surface being structured to support a small vehicle; and a second gradient member secured to said first gradient member at the distal end such that said second gradient member pivots at the distal end to the extent that said second gradient member is capable of an up position and a down position, said second gradient member defining a second surface, the second surface being structured to support the small vehicle, said first gradient member and said second gradient member defining a gradient between a ground surface and the bed of the truck when said second gradient member is at the down position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, the gradient being traversable by the small vehicle, said loading ramp being carried by the truck when said second gradient member is at the up position and said support structure is mounted to the truck, said loading ramp not limiting the storage space provided by the truck when said loading ramp is carried by the truck, wherein said loading ramp is configured to be stowed in a position that does not obstruct access to the truck bed.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said loading ramp makes available storage space provided by the truck otherwise occupied when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, and wherein said loading ramp is configured to allow for unobstructed access to the truck bed.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 2 wherein said loading ramp supports at least a portion of the small vehicle when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, and wherein said loading ramp is structured to maintain stability of the small vehicle during transport.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said mounting member is compatible with a receiver-type hitch, and wherein said mounting member is designed for quick attachment and detachment from the truck.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said support structure is adjustable such that the proximate end of said first gradient member is proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck regardless of the size of the truck, and wherein said support structure includes a mechanism for adjusting the height of said first gradient member.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against a rear bumper of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, and wherein said first gradient member is designed to accommodate variations in bumper height.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the proximate end of said first gradient member rests against the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, and wherein said first gradient member is configured to provide a secure connection to the truck bed.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a solid surface that enhances traction for the small vehicle.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the second surface defined by said second gradient member includes a solid surface that enhances traction for the small vehicle.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a mechanical device, said mechanical device moving said second gradient member between the up position and down position, and wherein said mechanical device is operable by a single user.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a locking member, said locking member locking said second gradient member at the up position, and wherein said locking member is designed for easy engagement and disengagement.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a mechanical device that assists in securing said second gradient member in the up position, and wherein said mechanical device is integrated into the support structure.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the truck is selected from the group consisting of a pickup truck, a sports utility vehicle, and a van.
